name: IRT Living (Independence Realty Trust)
notes: Researched from public irtliving.com pages (Resident Benefits, Contact Us). The online resident portal (24/7) lets residents submit rent payments, check the balance, schedule auto payments, submit maintenance requests, access documents and message staff. Flex partnership: pay part of rent up front and the rest later in the month (third-party split rent, not modelled). Esusu reports on-time rent to credit bureaus. Contact form: inquiry type Resident Relations with subjects Past Resident / Resident Financial / Resident Customer Service Inquiry; HQ Philadelphia, office hours M-F 8-5; corporate 312.924.1600. Fees, late fees, notice periods and sign-in fields not published (family defaults kept, inferred).

sources.title: Resident Benefits & Benefits at IRT Living | IRT Living

pay_online.note: Submit rent payments and check your balance in the 24/7 online resident portal.

autopay.note: Schedule auto payments in the online resident portal.

help.title: Paying rent online
paragraphs: The IRT online resident portal is open 24/7: submit rent payments, check your account balance, schedule auto payments, submit maintenance requests, open important documents and message your community staff.

help.title: Splitting rent with Flex
paragraphs: IRT partners with Flex, a renter's assistance program that lets you pay part of your rent up front and the rest later in the month, so you can spread out your budget. Sign up through Flex.

help.title: Building credit with Esusu
paragraphs: Through IRT's partnership with Esusu, your on-time rent payments can be reported to the major credit bureaus to help build your credit.

help.title: Contact IRT Living
paragraphs: Contact your community's leasing office, or use the Contact Us form: choose Resident Relations and a subject such as Resident Financial Inquiry, Resident Customer Service Inquiry or Past Resident Inquiry. IRT's corporate office (312.924.1600) is open Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; headquarters are in Philadelphia, with regional offices in Chicago and Tampa.

extra.intent: Using the IRT Living help pages, find the name of the partner that lets residents split rent into two payments. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
